vetSays.line: 🛡️ the person in their 40s, the lawyer, Ella, Harper, Vasyl and the woman in her 60s, with grey-streaked hair met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. the person in their 40s, the lawyer, Ella, Harper, the woman in her 60s, with grey-streaked hair are hurt.
🛡️ Salvatore, Ella, Vasyl, Nora and Oliver met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Salvatore, Ella, Vasyl, Oliver are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Ella, Harper, Nora, Sam and Oliver met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Ella, Harper, Nora, Sam, Oliver are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Salvatore, Ella and Sari met them at the door — 3 put down. Salvatore, Sari are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Ella, Giulia, Oliver and Sari met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Giulia, Oliver, Sari are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ulan just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

Giulia: "Oliver and Ulan blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 5 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."

regDeaths.name: stripes flowing where no wind blows
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
a soft green glow under the water
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
